section: 0. Setup (not an API call)
title: Seed the in-memory database with the synthetic universe
call: app.facts.seed.load_sme_into(store, sme, universe.start, universe.as_of) for every synthetic SME
shows: The five synthetic SMEs (2025-04-01 to 2026-09-30) are loaded into the fact ledger the same way `python -m app.facts.seed` seeds a dev server, except the grocery's first 20 bKash rows, which step 3 uploads through the API (so after the import the ledger equals the ground truth); every record is labelled synthetic.

section: 1. Health
title: Health and synthetic-data banner
shows: The API is up (contracts 1.2.0); data_mode_banner = 'synthetic' so every screen carries the synthetic-data banner; LLM mode fixtures, chain mode offline, no provider keys set.

section: 2. Demo accounts and sign-in

shows: Demo mode publishes 9 accounts on synthetic tenants; the passwords and each owner's current TOTP code are published on purpose for judges (redacted in this log).

section: 2. Demo accounts and sign-in
title: Sign in with email and password
shows: The right password alone is not enough: the owner has TOTP on, so the API answers totp_required and sets only a short-lived pending cookie.

section: 2. Demo accounts and sign-in
title: Second factor: TOTP code

section: 3. Ingest a bKash statement
title: Commit the preview
shows: The owner confirms: 20 transactions written, 0 skipped as duplicates of rows already in the ledger.

section: 3. Ingest a bKash statement
title: Upload the same file again

section: 3. Ingest a bKash statement
title: Import history

section: 4. Cash forecast, gaps, alerts and a what-if
title: Cash forecast
shows: From a closing balance of Tk 427842.00 on 2026-09-30, the engine simulates 1000 paths over 91 days (seed 20261020): buffer target Tk 296481.07, runway 91 days, lowest likely balance Tk 375635.08; each figure names its formula and input fact. The closing balance equals the synthetic ground truth (Tk 427842.00): the import neither lost nor double-counted a row.

section: 7. EXECUTE path: loan application through owner approval
title: Permission tiers for the actions used here
shows: Drafting an application is DRAFT; submitting it is EXECUTE and only the owner may execute; changing bank details is DENY for every role (four of the table's actions shown).

section: 7. EXECUTE path: loan application through owner approval
title: Draft the application pack for bd-bb-startup-fund
shows: Drafting stays inside Hishab and returns a submit_loan_application card at EXECUTE tier; the payload carries only facts the ledger holds and lists the ones the lender will ask for.

section: 7. EXECUTE path: loan application through owner approval
title: Ask the owner to approve the submission
shows: A pending approval (ap-5d0fb113b475f2a0) is created at EXECUTE tier; it expires 2026-10-20T16:27:41.666737Z.

section: 7. EXECUTE path: loan application through owner approval
title: Try to execute before approval
shows: Refused (approval_pending): nothing executes before the owner approves.

section: 7. EXECUTE path: loan application through owner approval
title: Approve without a step-up code
shows: Refused (step_up_required): approving an EXECUTE action needs a fresh TOTP code in X-Step-Up-Code.

section: 7. EXECUTE path: loan application through owner approval
title: Approve with a wrong step-up code
shows: Refused (invalid_step_up); the failed attempt is written to the audit chain and counts towards the lockout.

section: 7. EXECUTE path: loan application through owner approval
title: Read a fresh TOTP code (waited 18 s for the next window)
shows: The sign-in code cannot be reused (TOTP replay protection), so the owner takes the next code, here from the demo listing.

section: 7. EXECUTE path: loan application through owner approval
title: Approve with the fresh step-up code
shows: Approved by u-e6b5d82651e0d0d5 with step_up_verified = true.

section: 7. EXECUTE path: loan application through owner approval
